nativeEntryPoints.remaining: Every dynamic extension action, slash command and user-installed extension is not qualified by workspace-menu geometry.
All create/import/export/delete/drag/search/editor dialogs and error paths need explicit native owner review; category visibility does not prove them.
Provider-specific async transitions and every external paid provider operation have no blanket proof.
Each extension has its own menus/portals/styles/listeners; expanded settings inventory covers visibility only.

additionalCallbacks.state: Initialize interactables and scroll resets on added nodes/class changes. No per-container dedup for reset listener.
Bound open composer menu; observer stays for page lifetime, no disposable lifecycle exists.
Collect nonempty chunks local to recorder.
Cancel only if recorder sequence still current.
Sequence/story-owned encoding+transcription, late results ignored, errors visible, finally active=false.

findings.observed: When command input is focused index=-1. ArrowUp formula yields N-2 for N results, skipping last result.

findings.fix: Handle input/no-result start separately; ArrowUp starts last; test first/last wrapping and empty results.

findings.observed: Async apply closure uses discovered server data, then updates this.targets/native after await without row/current-server ownership. Another URL/discovery can clear/replace rows while pending. configureSdcppConnection also reassigns model after awaited loadSettingOptions.
findings.evidence: Source; no controlled concurrent native change experiment performed.
